newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police seize 500 kg cocaine, arrest four.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police seize 500 kg cocaine, arrest four.

text.p: Spanish police said on Thursday they had arrested four people and seized 500 kg of cocaine in one of Spain's most important strikes against drugs smuggling in recent years.
Police discovered the drugs with a street value of around 4.5 billion pesestas ($33.8 million) in a lorry in the northern town of Zaragoza.
Police said the four arrested could have been part of an international drugs ring.
